name: UK terrorism threat level
summary: UK national terrorism threat level Severe, meaning an attack is highly likely; no change found as of 24 Nov
state: The UK national terrorism threat level is Severe, meaning an attack is highly likely, after the Joint Terrorism Analysis Centre raised it from Substantial on 30 Apr 2026 (Home Office). Counter Terrorism Policing also gives the level as Severe, and searches on 24 Nov found no announced change.
for_you: Follow MI5 and Counter Terrorism Policing guidance: stay alert in crowded places and report anything suspicious to police. In an emergency call 999.
